eyebrow: DMSCO · OMS Web · New authorization engine
title: Authorization Admin

search.placeholder: Search a person — employee id, mobile, or part of the name…
search.hint: Search-first — the estate (~6,000 people) never loads. Results are a server query, capped at 50 rows.

grid.name: Name
grid.emptyHint: Type an employee id, a mobile number, or part of a name — the person grid stays empty until you search (first 50, refine to narrow).

detail.selectHint: Their roles, effective authorizations, and audit history appear here.

roles.outOfScopeHint: This role is outside your delegated scope — you can see it but not revoke it.
roles.removeBody: Revoke {{role}} from {{name}}? Access is removed immediately and the change is audited.
roles.autoCreate: If this person has no authorization record yet, their first role assignment creates it automatically (UserId = employee id, display name from the identity spine) — unguarded, but audited.

assign.title: Assign a role
assign.body: Pick a role to grant. Only roles you're entitled to assign are shown; the server re-checks on assign.
assign.empty: No assignable roles left — this person already holds every role in your scope.

effective.intro: The union of every grant this person resolves to — composites expanded to members, wildcards and $VAR field values shown. The "why can/can't they do X?" answer for a support call.

audit.none: No authorization changes recorded for this person.
audit.legend: Times shown as stored — audit rows are not converted between time zones.

access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to Authorization Admin
access.deniedHint: This screen needs the Authorization Admin permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.

rolesWs.hint: The role catalog loads whole (it's small) and filters as you type. Grants are bind-only — the grant catalog itself stays code+SQL-seeded.
rolesWs.selectHint: Its grants (or members), who holds it, and its audit history appear here.

roleDetail.systemBanner: Protected system role — its name and grants are locked and it can't be deleted (409 SYSTEM_ROLE). You can still edit its description and assign or revoke it to users.
roleDetail.readOnlyBanner: Read-only — you can view this role but not manage it (you lack the role-maintenance grant).
roleDetail.membersIntro: A composite is a bundle of single roles. Only single roles can be members — composites can't nest.
roleDetail.membersEmpty: Empty composite — allowed, but grants nothing until members are added.
roleDetail.unbindLockedHint: Seeded grants on a protected system role can't be unbound from here.
roleDetail.noHolders: No users hold this role directly.
roleDetail.jumpToUser: Open this person in the Users workspace
roleDetail.revokeBody: Revoke {{role}} from {{name}}? Access is removed immediately and the change is audited.
roleDetail.stillChecking: Still checking what references this role — try again in a moment.
roleDetail.auditNone: No changes recorded for this role.
roleDetail.unbindBody: Unbind {{grant}} from {{role}}? The role loses this authority immediately and the change is audited.
roleDetail.removeMemberBody: Remove {{member}} from the composite {{role}}? Holders of {{role}} lose the member's grants.
roleDetail.systemDeleteBody: {{role}} is a seeded system role and can't be deleted (409 SYSTEM_ROLE). You can still assign or revoke it to users.
roleDetail.deleteBody: Nothing references {{role}}, so it's safe to delete. This is audited and can't be undone.

newRole.title: Create a role
newRole.kindSingle: Single role — a bundle of grants
newRole.kindComposite: Composite role — a bundle of single roles
newRole.name: Role name
newRole.nameLock: The name is permanent — it can't be changed later (rename = create new → migrate holders → delete old).
newRole.duplicate: A role with this name already exists.
newRole.tooLong: Role names must be 50 characters or fewer.
newRole.compositeHint: The composite is created empty. Add its single-role members from the role's detail pane once it exists.

editRole.title: Edit {{role}}
editRole.nameLock: Immutable — names never change. To rename: create a new role, migrate holders, delete this one.
editRole.protectedNote: This is a protected system role — you can edit its description, but its name and seeded grants stay locked.

bindGrant.title: Bind grant to {{role}}
bindGrant.intro: Bind from the existing catalog only — grants aren't created here (they're code+SQL-seeded; a grant only means something if code checks it).
bindGrant.searchPlaceholder: Filter grants — object, field, or id…
bindGrant.empty: No grants left to bind — every catalog grant is already bound to this role.
bindGrant.wildcardBody: {{grant}} is a wildcard — anyone holding {{role}} gets it in full. The server binds it as-is; this confirmation is the guardrail.

addMember.title: Add member to {{role}}
addMember.intro: Only single roles can be members — composites can't nest.
addMember.empty: No single roles left to add — every single role is already a member.

deleteBlocked.title: Role is still in use
deleteBlocked.body: {{role}} can't be deleted while anything references it. Remove every holder, bound grant, and composite membership first — each act is audited — then delete.
deleteBlocked.hint: Blocked with 409 until empty. Tap a count to jump to its list.
